note: The feedback panel's words (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 20): every word it shows and the report's labels, as data. The panel copies a plain-text report to the clipboard for a friend to paste to Orb. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing personal is collected: the report holds the build, the match seed and setup, the match time, the platform and browser family, the settings, the tags and what the player typed.
